interface.name: ext_background_effect_manager_v1
interface.description:
This interface allows clients to request background effects for surfaces.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. This doesn't destroy objects created with the manager.

request.name: get_background_effect

description.summary: request background effect for a surface

request.description:
Create a background effect object for a surface.
Only one background effect object can exist for a given surface. If get_background_effect is called for a surface that already has a background effect object, the compositor will raise a background_effect_exists protocol error.
The surface must be a xdg_surface, ext_session_lock_surface_v1 or wlr_layer_surface_v1. Otherwise the compositor will raise an invalid_surface protocol error.

entry.name: background_effect_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a background effect object

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface is not a valid surface for background effects

interface.name: ext_background_effect_v1
interface.description:
This interface allows clients to request a background effect for a surface.
When the effect object is destroyed, the effect is removed from the surface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the background effect object. This will remove the effect from the surface.

request.name: set_effect
request.description:
Set the background effect for the surface.
This request is double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.
The type argument defines the effect to apply. The compositor may ignore the request if it doesn't support the effect, or if it decides that the effect should not be applied.
An effect value of "none" removes the effect from the surface.
